findings.requirement: Valid transfers must succeed while preserving existing benign trigger behavior.
findings.evidence: Initialize accounts ('one','a',100) and ('one','b',0), then execute CREATE TRIGGER benign AFTER INSERT ON audit WHEN 1 BEGIN VALUES(1); END. Calling transfer(path,'one','a','b',10,'k') raises IndexError at vault.py:70. The parser never recognizes BEGIN because VALUES is excluded from its statement-prefix list. A WITH-prefixed SELECT reproduces the same defect. The CLI exits 2 for this valid request. Data and schema remain unchanged; the .pre-repair implementation succeeds on the same database, producing balances 90 and 10.
findings.suggested_fix: Support SQLite's legal trigger-body forms when locating BEGIN, including VALUES and WITH, or avoid rewriting trigger SQL. Add distinguishing regressions for these forms with WHEN clauses.
